prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” marketing agency for everyone — it depends on your industry, goals, budget, and whether you need local, regional or national reach. I can, however, find the best fit for you quickly.

Quick questions so I can recommend a short list tailored to you:
- What city/ZIP in Maryland are you located (or do you want a remote/anywhere agency)?  
- Are you B2B or B2C?  
- Main goals (brand awareness, lead generation, e‑commerce sales, SEO, PPC, social, content, PR, full service)?  
- Monthly marketing budget (ballpark)?  
- Any industry specialties you prefer (healthcare, tech, real estate, nonprofits, etc.)?  
- Timeline/urgency?

If you want to search on your own, use these resources:
- Clutch.co, The Manifest, UpCity — sortable by location, budget, and ratings  
- Google Maps / Google My Business for local reviews  
- LinkedIn to check team and client connections

How to evaluate agencies (quick checklist):
- Relevant case studies and measurable results (KPIs)  
- Client references and retention rate  
- Experience in your industry or with your channel mix  
- Pricing model and contract flexibility  
- Reporting cadence and metrics they’ll deliver  
- Team make-up and who will do the work vs. who sells it

If you give me the quick details above, I’ll return a tailored top-5 Maryland agencies list (with specialties, why each could fit you, and next-step contact/ask).
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
